Business Days Calculator

Count working days between two dates, excluding weekends and your own custom holidays, with a full breakdown.

Only holidays that fall on a working day inside the range are subtracted.

📖 How to use

  1. Pick a start date and an end date.
  2. Optionally choose your weekend days.
  3. List any holidays, one YYYY-MM-DD per line.
  4. Press Calculate to see business days plus the full breakdown.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Can I add my own public holidays?

Yes. Type each holiday as YYYY-MM-DD, one per line. Only holidays that fall on a weekday inside your date range are subtracted.

Are the start and end dates inclusive?

Both dates are included in the count.

Does it work for past dates too?

Yes — the count updates for any dates, past or future, so it works for payroll, contracts and project planning.

My weekend isn't Saturday–Sunday. What can I do?

Use the optional weekend selector — choose Friday–Saturday or Thursday–Friday if that matches your country.
